abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions track the real variation in the app and would absorb an Items section with almost no copying; small flag-props and the duplicated card literal are the only drift from a 5.

findings.issue: Card construction is duplicated: the home load builds {id,name,label,sprite,types} inline while pokemonCards (app/src/lib/server/api.ts:186-197) builds the same shape; a change to card semantics (e.g. sprite resolution) must be applied in two places
findings.suggestion: Add a speciesCard(species, extra) helper in api.ts (or reuse pokemonCards via the species index) so the Card literal exists in one place

findings.issue: MoveTable re-declares a Row interface that mirrors MoveRow from app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.server.ts:33-43; adding or renaming a column requires synchronized edits in both files plus the value() switch
findings.suggestion: Move the row type (and ideally a column descriptor) into lib/util.ts and have both the load and the component import it

findings.issue: The hidden-ability flag spans three files (Card.hidden in util.ts:34, this span, pokemonCards' extra callback) and only one consumer (the abilities route); removing Abilities would strand dead code in all three
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is, but when a feature using an optional card field is removed, sweep the field and its rendering branch together

findings.issue: The var(--type-<name>) naming contract with tokens.css is duplicated here and in app/src/routes/types/+page.svelte:10, and the types list lacks the badge's fallback
findings.suggestion: Centralize the CSS-variable mapping in TypeBadge (or a helper) and give the type tiles the same var() fallback

findings.issue: showLevel boolean flag plus per-column value() switch; a future column with different formatting grows the switch and the flag set
findings.suggestion: Drive the table from a column descriptor (key, label, formatter, sortable) passed as props so new columns need no component edits

findings.issue: Search-box state syncing via afterNavigate + a local $state with a navigation.type check is subtle; future editors must understand SvelteKit navigation types to avoid regressions
findings.suggestion: The comment helps; consider deriving the displayed value from data and keeping only the debounce buffer local, to reduce the implicit contract

summary: A genuinely well-factored SvelteKit 3 app: all data-source, caching, and domain-index knowledge is confined to lib/server/api.ts, all card rendering to one component, and route files are thin typed pairs, so most changes land in one obvious place. The main editability costs are two duplicated shapes — the Card literal in the home load vs pokemonCards, and MoveTable's re-declared Row type — plus mild optional-flag creep that would strand dead code on feature removal. Idiomatically current with the framework (vite.config-based Kit 3 config, #lib alias, $app/state, PageProps), so future maintainers will find it familiar.
